description: Movie-poster-style QAnon graphic in red and black featuring a stylized portrait of Donald Trump beside the Washington Monument, U.S. Capitol dome, and a faded Seal of the President of the United States. Tagline text declares "The Hunt Is On" and "Hunters Become the Hunted — Patriots In Control," framing an "invisible war" against the D.C. swamp. A dedication line honors Trump, "Q-Team Patriots" and anons of the "Great Awakening," with the WWG1WGA slogan; signed by the artist "Cross for Country."

description: Screenshot of the ADS-B Exchange flight-tracking website showing military aircraft over the continental United States. The selected aircraft is callsign TRUST17, a U.S. Air Force Boeing E-4B Nightwatch (registration 73-1677, squawk 3655) at 7,850 ft descending near position 39.587/-84.179 (southwest Ohio). A hand-drawn red circle annotates a cluster of aircraft icons near Detroit/northern Ohio, and the sidebar lists other military callsigns including B-52s (TUFF21, TUFF22) and surveillance types.
flags: Red circle annotation implies significance of the Detroit-area aircraft cluster; the screenshot itself asserts nothing beyond tracking data
Some sidebar table digits small/low-contrast; minor transcription uncertainty in numeric columns

description: Close-up photograph of a black pen lying on a light wood-grain surface, framed vertically with black letterbox bars. The pen has a crosshatch-textured barrel and cap with a glossy black clip and a partially visible metallic/clear cap top; no branding is legibly visible. Posted by Q (filename PEN_.png), where such pen photos were taken by followers to imply the poster’s proximity to a presidential desk; nothing in the image itself establishes location or ownership.
flags: Pen brand/model not identifiable from the image; claims that it is a presidential pen or taken aboard Air Force One are unverified interpretations from posting context
